summary: Tested customer/admin auth isolation for /order (PublicOrder) after fixes in api.js interceptor and PublicOrder.jsx. All 10 review cases verified. Backend pytest (7/7) + Playwright end-to-end (cases 1,2,3,4,5,7,9) all pass. Wrong password / unknown phone / block flow keeps user on /order with inline error (data-testid=po-login-error). No redirect to /login occurs on 401/404 from /public/*. Ban screen appears after 5 failed attempts. Admin login regression works.
critical_code_review_comments: Passwords stored/compared in plaintext on customer records (server.py line 1129: customer.get('password') != data.password). Should be hashed (bcrypt). Not part of this fix scope but a security concern.
server.py > 1500 lines — consider splitting into routers per domain.

Console warning on /login: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)' — Login component performs a state update in render/effect chain; minor React hygiene issue.
test_credentials: Admin: admin/admin123. Customer: 777777777/test1234. Unknown phones used: 888888888, 999999999999.
seed_data_creation: None. Ensured public_blocks cleaned for 777777777, 888888888, 999999999999 before and after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Isolation fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js works: 401 responses from /public/* endpoints or from /order|/order-card pages do not redirect. Inline error uses data-testid=po-login-error and message text 'كلمة المرور غير صحيحة' for 401. Block after 5 failures works for both existing and unknown phones (verified via /api/public-blocks and 429 responses). Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_public_order_auth.py — reusable regression.
